reviewNote: This is the single consolidated ABI/fund-safety review CG4's acceptance requires. It reconciles all nine C60-C68 classification rows one-to-one against the F05 task manifest and the git index, records the QG1 local-family route, and binds the IG1/IG2 ABI freeze by digest. It records what is measured, not what is hoped for. CG4 is BLOCKED and refuses PASS: every one of the nine rows is still dependency-blocked in the manifest, six of them are missing at least one prescribed surface, QG1's own local-coverage verifier does not exist in the tree at all so QG1 is UNMEASURED rather than merely open, and the bound ABI freeze is BLOCKED with 11 IG2 violations. No row here is promoted, no C70 snapshot is created, and no deployment, live or readiness status is inferred. What this gate closes is CG4's own deliverable: the exact one-to-one reconciliation and the zero-debt report. The C60-C68 implementations themselves are owned by the forced-execution semantics and coverage rows that block them and are deliberately not attempted here.
